def basis(w):
    c=np.cos(w*t); s=np.sin(w*t)
    st={'1':np.ones_like(t),'x':x,'v':v,'x2':x*x,'v2':v*v,'xv':x*v,'sv':np.sin(v),'vav':v*np.abs(v),'x3':x**3,'sx':np.sin(x),'sqx':np.sqrt(x),'v3':v**3}
    cols=dict(st)
    for k in ['x','v','1']:
        cols['c*'+k]=c*st[k]; cols['s*'+k]=s*st[k]
    cols['c']=c; cols['s']=s
    return cols
def fitall(w,keys=None):
    B=basis(w)
    keys=keys or list(B)
    A=np.column_stack([B[k] for k in keys])
    b,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)
    return np.mean((y-A@b)**2)/np.var(y), dict(zip(keys,np.round(b,4)))
